notes.title: Version 1.10
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.10 of 'Gain Foxes' has been released! In this update, we have added and changed the following elements to make the game more enjoyable for a wider range of players based on your valuable feedback:[/b]

[b]Main Updates:[/b]
-Added Tips panel to the sales scene.
-More detailed product descriptions.
-More detailed descriptions during strategy selection.
-Adjusted the calculation processing of products.
-Reduced various negative elements.

With this update, players can obtain sufficient information and deploy a wide range of strategies. We hope you will update to the latest version and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed. [/b]
-Problems in the income calculation process caused by the fixes in Version 1.03.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.notes:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed[/b]
-A bug that caused more debtors than usual.

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed[/b]
-A bug in which achievements were not unlocked when the game was cleared.
-A bug caused by the behavior of the strategy decision button.
-A bug that caused the poor to become debtors after a crash when selling phantom stock.

[b]In addition, the walking speed of Phinne at game over has been revised upward.[/b]

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
[b]The following bugs have been fixed[/b]
-Fault in which the crime level due to praying was not subtracted.
-The bug where the game becomes unclickable when the game is over.

[b]In addition, adjustments have been made to make it easier for customers to visit the store in the early stages of the game.[/b]
